propositions: REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE environment variable must point to a TOML file that layers per-key over discovered config (CLI > REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env > REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE > discovered file > default)

Missing file paths in REBAR_LLM_CONFIG_FILE must raise a typed rebar config error naming the variable; REBAR_LLM_<KEY> env vars still take precedence over pointed file
read_reserved_section shallow-merge behavior must remain unchanged for non-llm reserved sections to prevent unintended scope creep into shared config machinery
